test_title: PYST 50: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the correctly spelt word to fill in the blank.

We _______________ to follow the traffic rules.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (ought)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ought"** means used to indicate duty or correctness, typically when criticizing someone's actions. (चाहिए/अनिवार्यता)

 
 
• **Example:** We ought to respect our elders.
 
 
 
• The correct word **"ought"** fits in the given sentence as it conveys the sense of obligation or necessity to follow the traffic rules. (चाहिए)
 
 
• **Example:** We ought to follow the traffic rules to ensure safety.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (ought)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **sut** (सुत): This is not a valid English word.
 
• **aught** (कुछ): Means anything at all, but it is not appropriate for this context.
 
 
• **Example:** Does it matter aught to you what they say?
 
 
 
• **oght** (अमान्य शब्द): This is not a valid English word.
